EQ base: 12-agent latency-profile market (9 NoiseTrader, 1 MarketMaker, 2 ValueTrader) over a 20s horizon with a log-normal per-message latency model. Per-message latency realized by ScenarioLatencyModel from latency_config; the sampled per-message delays and their arrival ordering are the held-out object. Each EQ unit overrides only latency_config (model / magnitude / dispersion / clip window) and, where noted, order-flow density, so the varied axis is the event-scheduler/causality semantic a static-batched port cannot reproduce.

GB throughput-scale base: one causally-coupled market with a 30-agent heterogeneous ecology (NoiseTrader/MarketMaker/ValueTrader/MomentumTrader) over a 30s horizon, driving ~68k events at ~20k events/sec.
